title: Sources
subtitle: Browse native work items from connected sources. Reads are read-only and require the source's daemon to be online with an approved binding.
no_sources: No work sources are connected yet
workspace_mismatch: This source belongs to a different workspace.
member_no_request: You can review existing read results, but only owners and admins can request new reads.
read_only_caveat: Read-only view of native items. No data is written back to the source, and dependency edges are not shown.
first_n_hint: Showing the first {{count}} items; the source may hold more.
status_claimed: The source daemon is running this read…
command_failed: The source did not complete this read
deadline_passed: This read did not finish before its deadline. It may still complete; check again rather than issuing a new read.
create_error: The read request could not be sent.
receipt_invalid: The read receipt did not match this request.
status_unknown: The outcome of this read is not known yet.
history_error: Existing read results could not be loaded.
source_disabled_hint: This source is disabled. New reads are blocked, but existing results remain inspectable.
native_readonly_note: Metadata is read-only, and graph execution is unavailable for native sources; enabling requires an approved enrollment.
